notes.title: New DEMO update 0.0.38
notes.content:
New demo update!
- New UI
- New JOURNAL feature
- Fixed multiple bugs
- Improved localization

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.35
notes.content:
Main enemy model added.
Improved physics (hopefully the bird doesn't go through objects anymore).
Improved lighting visuals.
Most of the demo texts are rewritten.
Reworked flying camera; it is now more responsive when flying near the ground.
Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.3
notes.content:
- New mechanic, learning soul's language. Now you can learn words, which are used in dialogues with souls.
- Added more stuff to explore on demo island.
- Reworked dive mechanic. Now you gain much more speed when you dive downwards.
- Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.2896
notes.content:
Added talking animation to birds.
Added sound effects for dialogues.
Better dialogue camera.
Better slow down in fly mechanic. 
Fixed some fps drops related to drawing vegetations.
Fixed bug related to different gravity power in fly state.
Fix wind sound on take off and landing.
Fixed bugs related to save/load system.
Fixed bug with starting new game after returning to menu.
Fixed bug when collides with other birds in air.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.2894
notes.content:
Small UI fixes.
Add feedback form at the end of the demo.

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.2893
notes.content:
A little bit more updates, thank you everyone for feedbacks!

- Better visual for landing animation.
- Fixed black screen on specific hardware, when changing graphic quality level.
- Changed camera behavior in dialogues, no more clipping.

notes.title: First demo update. Version 0.0.2891
notes.content:
It's first demo update, wow, still can't believe!

Thank you everyone for your feedbacks through in game option and social media!

Patch notes:
Ambience music in menu fix now reacts to music settings.
Ai shouldn't fly upside down anymore (hopefully). 
Sometimes tutorial about how to fish wasn't shown - its fixed now.
First music loop fix (before hugging with family). 

Have any questions?
Join discord, I would be happy to answer!

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content:
[h1]DEMO IS OUT![/h1]

Please, let me know in social media or through in game feedback system if you like it.
[b]Feedback really appreciated![/b]

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to join discord and ask me there.
I would be happy to chat!
